text:
kai: Quick sync note — building the SI trainer certification + marketplace bundle. Friday 9am PT meeting to finalize scope. Who can join?

maria: I'll be there. Need clarity on certification levels (bronze/silver/gold?) and what counts as proof.

luis: Suggest two tracks: "deploy+operational" and "integration+customization". Different lab exercises for each.

anya: Agree. For deploy track: live deploy (air-gapped optional), smoke tests, and monitoring alerts configured. For integration: SDK usage, function calling tests, and sample connector.

kai: Good. Also need to decide marketplace artifact: single product with optional add-ons (trainer kit, on-prem license). Legal wants exact verbiage for SLA.

maria: I'll loop in legal after we lock levels. Also we should require trainees to submit a short runbook as part of gold level.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Note — infra request INFR-920 created for temporary trainer VPC access. Expires 10 days after grant.

sophie: For hands-on labs, we should prep two reproducible scenarios: 1) minimal cloud deploy (Terraform) and 2) offline airgap using tarball. Will author lab steps.

luis: Terraform snippet for cloud deploy (to include in guide):

luis: ```hcl
module "redwood_deploy" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/marketplace/deploy-module"
  model = "redwood-edge-2"
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
}
```

anya: Nice. For the certification rubric, propose pass/fail plus scores for quality (0-5) and a short comment. Trainers sign off.

maria: How strict are we on recorded demos? Some SIs can't share live infra.

sophie: We can accept recorded demos for deploy steps but require live telemetry and log exports via our sandbox for any monitoring/rollback checks. Documented in FAQ.

kai: Metrics we want from pilot: average time to deploy, first-pass success rate, and trainer feedback score. Run pilot with 4 partner orgs.

luis: Budget: kits cost estimate = $1.2k / kit, plus shipping. Ops approval needed — I'll open PARTN-460.

anya: Timeline proposal: draft rubric & lab scripts by Tue EOD, terraform + airgap artifacts by Wed, deck + marketplace copy by Thu, pilot week after next.

maria: Can we gate gold certification on a short real-customer use case? E.g., partner demonstrates deployment for a sample customer request.

sophie: Probably okay for gold, but need to keep privacy. Use anonymized datasets or synthetic inputs. Add an anonymization checklist.

kai: Last: announcement cadence — private beta to pilot SIs first; public marketplace listing after 2 successful pilots. Partnerships will draft PR language in parallel.

maria: I'll create the calendar and a shared doc for rubric drafts: https://redwoodhq.internal/partnerships/si-cert-roadmap (edit access to squad).

luis: I'll drop initial Terraform module link into that doc.

kai: Thanks. People joining Fri 9am PT: maria, luis, anya, sophie, kai. If you can't make it ping here. :thumbsup:
